text:
[{"word":"banquet","pronun":"[ˈbæŋkwɪt]","translation":"n. 宴会，盛宴；宴请，款待
vt. 宴请，设宴款待
vi. 参加宴会","audio":"banquet.mp3"},{"word":"barely","pronun":"[ˈberli]","translation":"adv. 仅仅，勉强；几乎不；公开地；贫乏地","audio":"barely.mp3"},{"word":"bargain","pronun":"[ˈbɑːrɡən]","translation":"n. 交易；便宜货；契约
v. 讨价还价；议价；(谈价钱后)卖","audio":"bargain.mp3"},{"word":"barren","pronun":"[ˈbærən]","translation":"n. 荒地
adj. 贫瘠的；不生育的；无益的；沉闷无趣的；空洞的","audio":"barren.mp3"},{"word":"barricade","pronun":"[ˈbærɪkeɪd]","translation":"n. 街垒；路障；争论之处
vt. 设路障；阻碍","audio":"barricade.mp3"},{"word":"barrier","pronun":"[ˈbæriər]","translation":"n. 障碍物，屏障；界线
vt. 把…关入栅栏","audio":"barrier.mp3"},{"word":"basis","pronun":"[ˈbeɪsɪs]","translation":"n. 基础；底部；主要成分；基本原则或原理","audio":"basis.mp3"},{"word":"batch","pronun":"[bætʃ]","translation":"n. 一批；一炉；一次所制之量
vt. 分批处理","audio":"batch.mp3"},{"word":"batter","pronun":"[ˈbætər]","translation":"n. 击球手；（用鸡蛋、牛奶、面粉等调成的）糊状物；墙面的倾斜
vt. 猛击；打坏；使向上倾斜
vi. 接连猛击；向上倾斜","audio":"batter.mp3"},{"word":"beam","pronun":"[biːm]","translation":"n. 横梁；光线；电波；船宽；[计量] 秤杆
vt. 发送；以梁支撑；用…照射；流露
vi. 照射；堆满笑容","audio":"beam.mp3"},{"word":"beforehand","pronun":"[bɪˈfɔːrhænd]","translation":"adj. 提前的；预先准备好的
adv. 事先；预先","audio":"beforehand.mp3"},{"word":"behave","pronun":"[bɪˈheɪv]","translation":"vi. 表现；（机器等）运转；举止端正；（事物）起某种作用
vt. 使守规矩；使表现得…","audio":"behave.mp3"},{"word":"behavior","pronun":"[bɪˈheɪvjər]","translation":"n. 行为，举止；态度；反应","audio":"behavior.mp3"},{"word":"belly","pronun":"[ˈbeli]","translation":"n. 腹部；胃；食欲
vt. 使鼓起
vi. 涨满；鼓起","audio":"belly.mp3"},{"word":"beneficial","pronun":"[ˌbenɪˈfɪʃl]","translation":"adj. 有益的，有利的；可享利益的","audio":"beneficial.mp3"},{"word":"benefit","pronun":"[ˈbenɪfɪt]","translation":"n. 利益，好处；救济金
vt. 有益于，对…有益
vi. 受益，得益","audio":"benefit.mp3"},{"word":"betray","pronun":"[bɪˈtreɪ]","translation":"vt. 背叛；出卖；泄露（秘密）；露出…迹象","audio":"betray.mp3"},{"word":"beverage","pronun":"[ˈbevərɪdʒ]","translation":"n. 饮料","audio":"beverage.mp3"},{"word":"bewilder","pronun":"[bɪˈwɪldər]","translation":"vt. 使迷惑，使不知所措","audio":"bewilder.mp3"},{"word":"beyond","pronun":"[bɪˈjɑːnd]","translation":"prep. 超过；越过；那一边；在...较远的一边
n. 远处
adv. 在远处；在更远处","audio":"beyond.mp3"}]
